Name: Medieval Junimo Hut
Author: ChaoticSimpliciy
Description:
Reskin for the Junimo hut, intended to be installed alongside the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/419/?tab=2&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodfiles%2F%3Fid%3D419&pUp=1]Medieval Modern Buildings[/url] mod by Eemiestardew.

Installation instructions:
1: Extract contents of .rar
2: Make a backup of your original Junimo Hut.xnb  found in /content/buildings (in case you need/want to revert to the original)
3: Copy new Junimo Hut.xnb to /content/buildings
4: Enjoy

Version 1.1 ~ I forgot to put a door on the winter hut, so I added that back in. If you prefer the look of no door in winter, just get/keep version 1.0
Version 1.2~ Fixed a file format error that made 1.1 unusable. Special thanks to Sventastical for pointing out the error.

Downloads.Description: Themed to match Midieval Modern Buildings (added door in winter that I forgot) Special thanks to Sventastical for pointing out the error with my last file.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
